title: Coverage recovery Wave 02 part 7 — Eternl, Sequence, Bitkit, Blixt, VESPR
notes: Candidate event/evidence IDs are provisional and must be reallocated against fresh main during canonical promotion. Routine version updates are recorded as event_type 'other' because the candidate schema has no generic maintenance enum. VESPR receives current first-party product evidence only; no launch date is inferred.

events.title: Eternl v2.1.5.0 released
events.description: Eternl published v2.1.5.0 with a Ledger signing hotfix and marked the Eternl browser extension as available, documenting active extension maintenance in July 2026.

events.title: Sequence Wallet infrastructure update released
events.description: Sequence announced and deployed a major wallet infrastructure update with faster login, cross-network session improvements, recovery improvements, and EIP-1271 integration changes.

events.title: Bitkit Android v2.4.0 released
events.description: Synonym released Bitkit Android v2.4.0 with Trezor hardware-wallet support, background-payment reliability improvements, and numerous transfer, notification, widget, and Lightning fixes.

events.title: Blixt Wallet v0.9.0 released
events.description: Blixt Wallet v0.9.0 was released with lnd v0.20.0, automatic channel opening, BIP177 support, reliability fixes, and other wallet improvements.

evidence.title: Eternl updates / release notes — v2.1.5.0
evidence.notes: First-party release notes list v2.1.5.0 as released 2026-07-10 and mark Eternl Extension available.

evidence.title: Sequence Wallet update - A better, faster, and smoother experience for builders and users
evidence.notes: First-party Sequence post announcing that a major wallet infrastructure update was pushed on 2023-06-21.

evidence.title: Bitkit Android v2.4.0
evidence.notes: Official Synonym Bitkit Android release with signed APK assets and detailed changelog.

evidence.title: Blixt Wallet v0.9.0
evidence.notes: Official Blixt Wallet release with mainnet/testnet APK assets and release notes.

evidence.title: VESPR Wallet official GitHub organization
evidence.notes: Official VESPR GitHub organization identifies VESPR as a non-custodial Cardano wallet available on iOS, Android, and browser extension platforms. This supports current product existence but not an original launch date.
